sections.heading: What is trending: “waszyngton”
paragraphs: “waszyngton” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for PL (snapshot taken 2026-11-16T09:41:58+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 5,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage

list: “Zaskakujący scenariusz w sprawie Jensena Huanga. Nvidia może zaskoczyć” — Next Gazeta.pl
“Sojusznicy Jensena Huanga naciskają na zarząd Nvidii. Walka o powrót na fotel prezesa” — Business Insider Polska
“Gigant i szpiedzy. Chiński wywiad jest groźny, ale my go nie rozumiemy” — WP Wiadomości

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Sun, 15 Nov 2026 22:50:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-16T09:41:58+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-16T09:42:52+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
